summary: Connect JTBD, OKRs, and continuous discovery to product outcomes. Build a strategy canvas and 12-month roadmap in this practical course.
lede: Outcome-driven product management helps product managers, business analysts and digital transformation leads link product decisions to user needs and measurable outcomes. Using a real product or service, participants define outcomes, conduct customer discovery, test hypotheses, select measures and prioritise a 12-month roadmap with JTBD, OKRs and an Opportunity Solution Tree.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who connect digital product decisions with customer needs, delivery capacity, and measurable organisational outcomes.
audience: Government and NGO Digital Service Leads
prerequisites: Working familiarity with a digital product, service, project, or delivery context is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a product or service example for the roadmap exercises where practical; you can use a representative case if you cannot share internal details. Advanced product analytics and AI-assisted research synthesis are introduced at a conceptual and operational-awareness level, not as implementation training.
